**What's new**

- Linux and macOS builds, of the same code as 1.0.8: an AppImage for Linux and a zip for macOS, added to this release when they are built, a little after the Windows one. The macOS build is for Intel Macs and runs through Rosetta on Apple silicon. Only the Windows build has been tested with inFAMOUS Second Son so far, so please send a log if you try one of the others.
